title: Summary: Consolidation: Vosotros in Peninsular Spanish

sections.content:
Vosotros is the heartbeat of social interaction in Spain:
• Presente: *-áis, -éis, -ís*
• Imperativo: infinitive minus *-r* plus *-d* (*hablad, venid*), reflexive drops *-d* (*sentaos*)
• Pasados: *habéis hablado* (hoy), *hablasteis* (ayer)
• Pronombres: *os* y *vuestro/a/os/as*.

items.spanish: ¡Chicos, venid a casa y tomad algo!
items.english: Guys, come home and have a drink!
Did you go to the concert last night?

sections.content: Embrace vosotros freely whenever chatting with peers, colleagues, or groups of friends across Spain.
